sources.title: Meta's omniASR-CTC-300M: A Lightweight Multilingual ASR Model for ...
sources.snippet: Meta's omniASR family has long been a go-to for developers seeking open-source multilingual speech recognition, but its full-scale variants often demand hefty compute and external language models. Enter the omniASR-CTC-300M — a 300-million-parameter CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) variant that strips away the language modelling head to deliver a lean, streaming-friendly ASR ...

sources.title: CTC Models (Fast ASR) | facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) model family in the omnilingual-asr system. CTC models provide fast, efficient automatic speech recognition suitable for real-time and high-throughput transcription scenarios. These models prioritize inference speed while maintaining competitive accuracy across 1600+ languages.
